I confirm each booking myself

If a business sends you an invoice or a quote: the details it typed about you (your name, company, phone, email, address, TIN), what it billed, and any payment SMS you paste on the invoice’s page to show you paid. Only that business sees them, and anyone it gives the invoice’s link to.

If you book a time with a business: your name, your WhatsApp number, what you booked and when, and any note you add. Only that business sees them. Other clients only ever see which times are free, never who booked.

If you used Instagram or Facebook to import your shop, we keep only what you chose to import (such as photos and captions) as part of your shop. To remove the connection, remove Shopi in your Instagram or Facebook settings under Apps and websites, and send us a deletion request as above; we delete what we got from it within 30 days.
